name: Side-Step Aerobic Drill

instructions.description: Stand with knees soft and feet parallel.
Step to one side and bring the other foot toward it.
Continue laterally for several steps, then reverse direction.
Keep the torso facing forward and avoid crossing the feet.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.

variations.variationDescription: Side-Step Aerobic Drill — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Keep steps controlled and the path clear.
